catalogue.title: Products
catalogue.description: Shared marketplace product records. Prices and sale conditions belong to seller offers.
catalogue.offersHelp: Each offer belongs to a shop and a product. Open its record to inspect or correct its sale conditions.
catalogue.legacyHelp: Previous catalogue, preserved for existing references and tools, separate from the marketplace catalogue.
catalogue.name: Product name
catalogue.noOffers: No seller offers are linked to this product.
catalogue.reasonHelp: At least 5 characters. This change is recorded and takes effect immediately.
catalogue.invalid: Check the fields and their permitted lengths.
catalogue.created: Product created in the marketplace catalogue.
catalogue.formHelp: These details are shared by the shops. Prices, stock and MOQ belong to seller offers.
catalogue.stockHelp: Stock stays in its dedicated workflow; this correction never changes reservations.
catalogue.reviewRequired: Process the draft or pending revision in moderation first. Administrative correction does not publish an offer.
catalogue.restrictedOffers: Seller sale conditions are restricted to direction.

availability.title: Availability
availability.help: “Out of stock” and “Restocking” take the offer off sale on the site and the app, whatever its quantity.
availability.helpAll: The same availability applies to every offer of this product (archived ones excepted). Quantities do not change.
availability.quantityHelp: Physical units at the seller, {reserved} of them already reserved for customers.
availability.untracked: This shop does not track its stock: only the availability can be set.
availability.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. new delivery expected next week
availability.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
availability.quantityRequired: Enter a quantity above the reserved units to put the offer back on sale.
availability.savedAllMissing: Availability updated. {count} tracked offer(s) without stock remain unsellable: enter their quantity.
